Diagrammatic map of weights and measures in use in 27 Mediterranean and European seaports.

Diagrammatic map of weights and measures in use in 27 Mediterranean and European seaports. Oriented with north to the right. Each port city is represented by a vignette of a prominent local tower and the vignettes are connected by rhumb lines. Manuscript: pen-and-ink (light brown) and watercolors. Includes notes and an aerial view of the walled city of Siena in the upper margin (neck of sheet). LC Nautical charts on vellum, 4. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
